revenue_yoy.description: Total revenue YoY growth rate vs Q-4 baseline

operating_related_expenses_margin_delta_.description: Operating-related expenses as % of total revenue, delta vs Q-4

selling_and_general_expenses_margin_delt.description: SG&A as % of total revenue, delta vs Q-4

depreciation_and_amortization_margin_del.description: Depreciation and amortization as % of total revenue, delta vs Q-4

equity_income_abs.description: equity_income absolute dollar value for the target quarter (predict the amount directly; 0 if none expected)

other_expense_net_abs.description: other_expense_net absolute dollar value for the target quarter (predict the amount directly; 0 if none expected)

interest_expense_net_yoy.description: interest_expense_net YoY growth rate vs Q-4

nci_abs.description: nci absolute dollar value for the target quarter (below-pretax line; predict directly, 0 if none expected).

tax_rate.description: Effective GAAP tax rate for the target quarter (decimal, e.g. 0.14 = 14%; may be negative in a benefit quarter). Choose from the GAAP historical anchors provided; a discrete tax item can push it far from any of them.

shares_abs.description: shares: diluted weighted-average share count for the target quarter (predict the count directly; drifts slowly with buybacks/issuance).
